limitations: The Spearman correlation is computed on only 13 brain-region points (one per region), so the p-value has limited statistical power; a non-significant result does not rule out a moderate association.
The mean profiles are arithmetic means of nTPM across all genes in each set; genes with very high expression in a single region can dominate the mean.
The heatmap uses linear scale; low-expression regions may be visually compressed relative to high-expression regions.
